name: Cart Drawer
description: A monochrome slide-over cart: line items stagger in, the free-shipping meter fills after landing, totals count up, and undo lives in place. A sheet on phones.

props.name: items
props.description: Line items: id, name, variant, price, qty, art (notebook | mug | socks | pencil) and the product's colour for the drawn thumbnail.

props.name: upsell
props.description: One suggested add-on under the items (an item without qty, plus a pitch). Pass null to hide.

props.name: freeShippingThreshold
props.description: Subtotal that unlocks free shipping. Drives the progress bar.

props.name: currency / locale
props.description: Passed to Intl.NumberFormat for every price.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Leave undefined to let the component manage it. The built-in trigger button always reopens it.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the drawer opens or closes (trigger, close button, scrim, Esc or a sheet swipe).

props.name: shipsFrom
props.description: Mono line under the title, after the item count.

props.name: note
props.default: "VAT included. Free returns within 60 days, no questions."

props.name: onCheckout
props.description: Called with the live items when Checkout is pressed.

props.name: strategy
props.description: Cover the viewport, or stay inside the nearest positioned parent (as in the demo).

props.name: undoSeconds
props.description: How long a removed item can be restored.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one signal colour: the total capsule on the checkout button.

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black panel with white ink, or the white inverse.
